 Court No. - 4
 Hon'Ble Ajit Kumar, J. 
Hon'Ble Swarupama Chaturvedi, J.
1.
Compliance affidavit has been filed pursuant to the last order of this Court passed on 29.10.2025.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

3. In compliance affidavit, an undertaking has been advanced by the petitioner that he shall comply with all the directions contained in the license granted to run the retail meat shop and follow the guidelines provided by the Food Safety and Standard Authority of India.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: A photograph has also been annexed which shows that a bamboo chick curtain has been put at the door of the shop so as to not make raw meat visible from outside.

4. In the circumstances, we dispose of this petition with a direction to the respondent Authorities not to interfere with the petitioner, if so long as he complies with the undertaking given before this Court and continues to hang a chick curtain at outer door and window, if any, of the shop not to make the hanging raw meat visible from outside.

5. However, in the event, petitioner fails to follow any of the conditions and violates the undertaking advanced before the Court, he shall deserve cancellation of his license subject of course, to the show-cause notice by the Authorities.
